def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params

    h = p[2] + p[3]*t + p[4]*s + p[6]*c + p[7]*np.exp(-t) + p[8]*t*s + p[9]*t*c
    return p[0]*t + p[1]*P*np.log(P) + h/P
